reference_observation.description: Operator reported the right rear hip reference horizontal by eye; this angle is the raw reading transformed by the old nominal calibration candidate.

diagnostic.formula: C8-C9 = [0, -L*cos(q), -L*sin(q)] mm in the body frame
diagnostic.interpretation: The height difference is a model prediction conditional on the old candidate angle, not a measured physical height or a motion target.

caveats: Illustrative schematic, not to scale; projected rotation centers, no robot mesh or photograph.
The old calibration and new horizontal reference were aligned by eye, not externally measured.
Model center distance does not establish that the assembled robot has this exact dimension.
Align the center line to the body lateral reference, not curved PLA edges or the floor.
No automatic offset update, angle wrapping, standing command, or runtime approval.
